- The active ingredients are released gradually, providing sustained sun protection throughout the day.

description:
Stay Fresh & Protected All Summer with the Ultimate Summer Essentials Trio! ☀️ 

Beat the heat with this power-packed trio designed to keep you cool, fresh, and sun-safe all day!   
✨ What’s Inside?  

✅ 1% Salicylic Acid Bodywash – Fights body acne, prevents strawberry skin, and provides a cooling sensation after every wash ❄️🚿.
✅  4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll-On – Keeps underarms fresh, odour-free for 12 hours  and visibly reduces pigmentation ✨.
✅  Ultralight Sunscreen – Blends in 3 seconds, zero white cast, and suits acne-prone skin for all-day sun protection ☀️💖.  

Stay Cool, Stay Fresh, Stay Protected—Your Skin Will Thank You! 💛

Step 1 : 1% Salicylic Acid Bodywash : Take adequate amount of bodywash in your palms/loofah. Apply on wet skin in a gentle circular motion.
 Step 2 : 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On : Roll evenly on underarm skin and allow the product to dry completely. 
 Step 3 : Ultralight Sunscreen  : On cleansed and toned skin, apply a generous amount of sunscreen on the face and neck.

faqs.question: Is this kit suitable for all skin types?
faqs.answer: Yes, this kit is suitable for all skin types. The 1% Salicylic Acid Bodywash gently exfoliates the skin, leaving it hydrated and refreshed. The 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On has no alcohol or aluminium, and is suitable for sensitive skin. The Ultralight Sunscreen is lightweight and suits acne prone skin

faqs.question: Will the sunscreen leave a white cast?
faqs.answer: Be Bodywise Ultra Light Sunscreen has a lightweight aqua gel like texture and doesn't leave a white cast.

faqs.question: Does the sunscreen have fragrance?
faqs.answer: No, this sunscreen has no added fragrance.

faqs.question: Is the bodywash effective against Strawberry Skin?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Salicylic Acid in this gently exfoliates the skin, thereby reducing strawberry skin

faqs.question: Will the Underarm roll on prevent body odour for long?
faqs.answer: Yes, the 4% AHA BHA Underarm Roll On not only keeps you fresh for 12 hours by killing odour causing bacteria, it also reduces pigmentation in underarms over time.
